original_en: Molded by the controlling\rforce of a starship high in\rorbit, millions of particles\rbegin to compress, bond,\rfuse, collide, cling, spin\rand explode. Within that\rchaos a human form begins to\rtake shape and within that,\rintelligence.\r   Slightly disoriented, \r% steps reborn from\rthe electromagnetic chaos and\ronto the surface of a new\rworld.\r   An unfriendly world...
translation_zh: 受高軌道星艦的\r控制之力塑形，無數\r粒子開始壓縮、結合、\r融合、碰撞、纏繞、\r旋轉、爆裂。混沌之\r中漸現人形，意識亦\r在其中萌芽。\r   略感失神，\r% 自電磁混沌\r中再生而出，踏上一\r個嶄新的世界。\r   一個並不友善的\r世界……

original_en: Situated on a low, glassy\rtable a crystalline orb\rthrobs dully as % \renters the room, probes\rblindly with light-formed\rfingers. More fingers form,\rbegin to weave together, knit\rthemselves into the image of\ran alien visage.\r   "Welcome to the OMEGAN\rForward Observational \rStation. We review all the\rtaped narrowcasts from all\rthe local Sector news\rservices. To access a\rnarrowcast, simply step in\rfront of a monitor. Like most\rcommunications in the Local\rGroup, your scanner will take\rcare of all your translation\rneeds."
translation_zh: 矮玻璃桌上置一晶\r球，當 % 步入\r室內時微微脈動，伸\r出由光形成的手指盲\r目探索。更多手指顯\r現、彼此交織、編成\r一張外星臉孔的模樣。\r   「歡迎來到歐米茄\r前哨觀測站。我們彙\r整本地各星區新聞的\r所有錄影。如欲收看，\r只需站到螢幕前。如\r同本群多數通訊，掃\r描器會替您處理翻譯。」

original_en: "Continued violence\rreported in Sector \rKornephoros as Cin Sae Spawn\rmake new appearances on\rEltanin VII and Rutilicus\rColony. original_en: Beneath a plaque labelled\rSector Izar, a view of a\rspacecraft drifts across the\rscreen, leaps across a\rpanorama of stars.\r   "That ship looks like the\rETS!" % gasps, \rreferring to the alien craft\rthat exploded when the Earth\rdisappeared. Suddenly a voice\rbegins to accompany the\rvideo.\r   "Forward Station, be\radvised that something is\rmalfunctioning with the\rdrive. translation_zh: 「在他星區仍籠罩\r於難關之際，阿吉比\r星區市民今夜歡欣雀\r躍，兩大盛事正型塑\r本星區未來。阿吉比\r四號伊許陶總統慶祝\r第二度就職，塔利薩\r二號珍娜公主籌備本\r星區史上最盛大的婚\r禮之一。我們當然會\r親臨現場為您直播。」

original_en: "Dhoven Ambassadors will\rmeet with the leaders of\rother races soon in a meeting\rto resolve the issue of Scroe\rand Evian intrusions into\rSector Hyades. The sector,\rdeclared an open territory\rthree spinphases ago, has\rbeen riddled with acts of\rattrition for months now."
translation_zh: 「多文使節將與他\r族領袖會晤，商議解\r決史庫人與伊維恩人\r侵入海雅德斯星區之\r爭。該星區於三個自\r轉週期前宣告為開放\r領域，數月來一直\r飽受消耗戰所苦。」

original_en: "Scientists are still\rcautiously monitoring the\rformation of a white hole in\rSector Zaurak as lifeforms\rsector wide begin to scramble\rfor safety. Einreb Wahs has\rmore on that story."\r   A starlike glob blazes on\rthe monitor as a\rcommentator's voice drones\rscientific data.\r   "As you know, a white hole\ris the essential opposite of\ra black hole. original_en: "The queen of the Ethnys\rhas confirmed reports that\rthieves have in fact broken\rinto the temple on Ankaq I\rand stolen, quote, several\ritems of importance on which\rour existence as a species\rmay depend, endquote. What\rthis revelation will mean to\rthe lifeforms in Sector\rAnkaq, I am not certain. What\rit means to the queen of\rAnkaq, apparently a great\rdeal. original_en: His thin leathery lips\rdrawn into a taut line, the\ralien reads a statement on\rthe looped message.\r   "Do not, I repeat, do not\renter Sector Alnasl under any\rcircumstances. Our planetary\rdefense mechanisms have been \rcompromised and the problem\rmay spread to other sectors.\rOminar in all sectors are \radvised NOT to update\rstrandware. original_en: "A demographic study of\rsector Algieba reveals that\rthe sector is dominated by\rthe Algiebian empire. A\rtactical survey indicates\rthat their starfleet is \rinferior to that of ships\rfrom other societies and can \rbe easily defeated.  End file\rAlgieba."
translation_zh: 「阿吉比星區人口\r研究顯示，本星區由\r阿吉比帝國主宰。戰\r術調查指出，其星艦\r隊遜於他族船艦，輕\r易可破。阿吉比檔案\r結束。」

original_en: "Accessing files.  Please\rwait. The majority of Sector\rKornephoros was settled by\rrefugees fleeing the\roppressive government systems\rof Sectors Izar and Ankaq.\rWhat technology they possess\rwas salvaged from the scrap\rmetal starships. translation_zh: 「正在存取檔案，\r請稍候。庫尼弗洛斯\r星區多由難民開拓，\r他們逃離伊薩與安卡\r克星區的高壓政體。\r其科技皆自廢鐵星艦\r拼湊。發展雖較他星\r區為慢，火力仍勝過\r阿吉比星區的巡航艦。\r庫尼弗洛斯檔案結束。」

Oortizam labs is\rlocated in this sector as is\rthe Life Gallery, both which\rserve the dual purposes of\rrecreation and research. A\rfew native populations also\rmake their homes in this\rsector, notably the Eldarin\rpeople. End file Caroli."

original_en: "The Rana Collective\rcontrols both the resources\rand the means of production\rfor a host of mid-tech items,\rplacing the citizens of the\rZaurak in a firm mid-tech \rposition. Many political\ranalysts theorize that\rKornephoros sector will\reventually fall into a\rgovernment like that in\rZaurak sector. End file\rZaurak."

original_en: The android's dead eyes\rseem to glint with a life as\rit begins to regurgitate its\rlast data file.\r   "As monitor of the OMEGA\rForward Observational\rStation, I am restricted in \rdispensing information about\rthis sector. I will warn you\rthat any attempts to\rpenetrate more deeply into\rSector Izar will be met by\rsevere hostility by OMEGA and\rour forces.  Only the Ominar\rcan parallel our technology\rand they would be ill advised\rto come against us.  End File\rIzar."
translation_zh: 機器人死寂雙眼似\r現生機，開始吐露最\r後一筆檔案。\r   「身為歐米茄前哨\r觀測站監督，我對本\r星區資訊揭露受限。\r警告您：任何更深入\r伊薩星區之嘗試，將\r遭歐米茄與我方部隊\r嚴厲敵視。唯歐米納\r可與我方科技匹敵，\r若敢來犯，亦屬不智。\r伊薩檔案結束。」

original_en: "There is cause to be\rconcerned with the state of\raffairs in Sector Alnasl.\rVery possibly the most \rtechnologically advanced race\rin the Local Group, the\rOminar have been reporting\rbouts of mass insanity and\rviolence. These\rdevelopments may well be\rconnected to the disaster of\rthe Sol Experiment. End File\rAlnasl."
translation_zh: 「阿納斯爾星區局\r勢堪憂。歐米納人很\r可能是本群中科技最\r先進的種族，卻屢傳\r集體瘋狂與暴力事件。\r在歐米納瘋狂之因查\r明並修復前，無論何\r種情況皆應避開本星\r區。此事很可能與太\r陽系實驗災難相關。\r阿納斯爾檔案結束。」

original_en: Lopsided atop a snake-like\rcoil of sparking wires, a\rsynthetic head moves its lips\rbut makes no sound.\r   "It's an android, or at\rleast an android's head,"\r% says. "Whoever \rraided the station went to\rgreat trouble to make sure\rthat this android didn't talk\rto anyone again. Reminds me\rof the old mafia style\rexecutions back on Earth."

original_en: "Your profiles do not\rmatch those of the \raggressors," the man says,\rhis greyish eyes irising \rwider open. Taking a few\rmechanical steps forward, he\rextends his hand to touch\r%'s face. "You are not\rsynthetic. You are living\rcreatures?"\r   "Yes," % replies,\runderstanding now that the\rhuman looking creature is in\rfact an android.\r   "We have been attacked,"\rthe android says. original_en: "I was advised by my\rsupervisors to keep a watch\rout for humans coming from\rEarth," the android says. "We\rregret that we cannot give\ryou further information on \rthe disappearance of your\rplanet. As you might have\rguessed, it was a tragic\raccident. Our analysis of the\rsituation is most certainly\rsimilar to your own. You will\rhave to find all the parts to\rthe Centauri Device and \rreconstruct it if you hope to\rbring your world back from\rthe wormhole trap. The safest\rpath, and sanest, would be to\rtry Algieba Sector. There is\ra part that is named after\rone of that sector's stars, \rafter all."
translation_zh: 「上級指示我留意\r來自地球的人類，」\r機器人說。「很遺憾\r我們無法提供更多有\r關貴行星消失的訊息。\r如你所料，那是場慘\r烈意外。我方分析想\r必與你方相近。若想\r將世界自蟲洞陷阱救\r回，必須找齊半人馬\r裝置所有零件並重組。\r最安全也最明智的路\r線是阿吉比星區。畢\r竟其中一件零件正是\r以該區某顆恆星命名。」

original_en: A gear whines as the\randroid turns his head.\r   "I am not fully restored\rto functioning," the android\rsays."If you would be so\rkind, please find all the\rheads and use this to \rreactivate them. Perhaps one\rof them has a profile on\rwhatever alien force was \rresponsible for the attack on\rthe station."  \r   A device thumps solidly \rinto %'s palm as the\randroid hands it over.  \r   "I must now shut down for\rinternal diagnostics."
